events.name: Bash
events.head: Check worktree state against origin/main
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git status --short | head -20 && git log --oneline -5 && git fetch -q origin && git log --oneline HEAD..origin/main | wc -l && git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Merge origin/main into branch
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git merge -q --no-edit origin/main 2>&1 | tail -20; git status --short | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate conflict hunks
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && for f in app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py cloud/src/index.ts cloud/src/jobs-day2.ts docs/onboarding-v3/coverage.json app/src/generated/playbook/index.ts; do echo "== $f"; git diff --diff-filter=U -- $f | grep -n '^[-+ ]\(<<<<<<<\|=======\|>>>>>>>\)' | head; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find conflict markers
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && grep -n '^<<<<<<<\|^=======$\|^>>>>>>>' app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py cloud/src/index.ts cloud/src/jobs-day2.ts docs/onboarding-v3/coverage.json | head -40; grep -c '^<<<<<<<' app/src/generated/playbook/index.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: View conflicts
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && sed -n 470,492p app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts; echo ----; sed -n 3450,3468p cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py; echo ----; sed -n 120,155p cloud/src/index.ts; echo ----; sed -n 15,40p cloud/src/jobs-day2.ts

events.text: Merging origin/main into the T-300 branch now and resolving 6 conflicts.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect remaining conflict context
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git grep -n '__instantly/add\|S\["instantly"\]' origin/main -- . | cut -c1-160 | head; echo ---; grep -n 'zoomEnsurePolls\|SocialLeads\|inEnsureCampaign\|hrEnsure\|calendlyEnsure' cloud/src/jobs-day2.ts | head; echo ---; sed -n 95,125p docs/onboarding-v3/coverage.json; sed -n 700,725p docs/onboarding-v3/coverage.json

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether T-299 landed in origin/main
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git merge-base --is-ancestor a5b5486e origin/main && echo t299-in-main; git ls-tree --name-only origin/main cloud/src/connectors/ cloud/src/ | grep -i 'instantly\|m365'; git log --oneline -3 origin/main; git log --oneline origin/main -- cloud/src/connectors/instantly.ts | head -3

events.name: Bash

events.input: $ git merge-base --is-ancestor a5b5486e main && echo t299-in-local-main; git rev-list --count origin/main..main; git rev-list --count main..origin/main; git branch -a --list '*299*'; git ls-tree --name-only main cloud/src/connectors/ | grep -ci instantly; grep -n 'T-299\|T-272\|T-264\|T-300' /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -12 | cut -c1-220
